description:
The macro for awakening the Dosa character in the game Black Desert in 2025 offers the creation of combinations that ensure maximum effectiveness and protection. At the same time, it is important to turn off the help of the sight, raise the camera a little higher and always aim at the back of the targets using the crosshair of the game. This approach allows you to inflict enormous damage and maintain a high degree of protection.

On the quick access toolbar, under the number «1», place the wake-up skill. It will be used with the activated skill «Z», which increases the parameters. Do not forget to block the rage of the black spirit with the keyboard shortcut Alt + B.

**New addons for July 22, 2025:**
1. Wooden Bend: -20 DP / critical damage +5%.
2. Metal heat treatment: The application rate is +10% / +20 DP.
3. Water weave: +30% chance of crit / +10% application rate.
4. Fire Spread: Crit probability +30% / Back damage +5%.
5. Earth Gathering: +10% movement speed / back damage +5%.
6. Metal casting: -20 DP / critical damage +5%.

**Combos:**
1. Start with the right mouse button (hand swipe), if you are standing and waiting for respawn, use W + F (consecrated cloud) or Veluum Slash. Veluum can be replaced with Shift + E if there is no recharge.
   - Note: These skills are selected to reduce the movement distance and increase the speed of the Shift + E skill.
2. Shift + E (water weave).
3. S + lmb (metal casting).
4. Q + S (earth gathering).
5. S + rcm (fire spreading).
6. Shift + LMB (metal heat treatment) – here you can use evasion using Misty Steps.
7. Shift + Q (ground splash).
8. Dodge on WASD + Shift (Misty Steps) or replace with E (pressing on the ground) for slow targets.
9. Shift + RKM (fiery flame) – you can use combos on slow targets.
10. Shift + F (Wooden fold) – When pressing the ground immediately after Shift + F, anticipate and hold pressing “E».
11. E (tapping on the ground) – use after Shift + Q on slow enemies.
12. F (wooden stake) – full animation.

This combination of skills and addons will provide you with excellent results in battle, making your character almost invulnerable and incredibly powerful in attack.

title: Nighwalker Leap Sand
description:
Description:

This macro was created specifically for the Nightshade characters, ensuring the smooth application of two skills at once. It combines a jump with a «Dark Jump» (F2) and a «Sand Throw» (F3) in one click, allowing you to instantly move to the target and immediately immobilize it. A short delay of 72 ms between the two skills guarantees the correct execution of both commands without failures.

The macro is especially useful in the following situations:

- **Single Targets**: Quickly activate an attack on isolated players before they have time to react.
- **Objectives on horseback**: Interrupt the escape of players on horseback and force them to join the battle. 

How to use a macro:

- **Bind to a key**: Assign a macro to a key located next to your movement keys (for example, Q, E or the mouse button) for quick and convenient use.
- **Select a goal**: Make sure that the desired goal is selected. Use manual or automatic guidance if necessary.
- **Execute the macro**: Press the assigned key to activate the sequence. You will instantly move to the target with a «Dark Jump» (F2) and immediately stop it with a «Sand Throw» (F3).

Tips for effective use:

- **Optimal Timing**: Make sure you are within reach of the «Dark Jump» before activating the macro.
- **Keep an eye on reloading**: Make sure both skills are ready to use for continued effectiveness.

Why does it work:

A delay of 72 ms is critically important for the «Sand Throw» to correctly follow the «Dark Jump», as too fast activation can lead to a failure in the second skill. By placing this macro next to the movement keys, you will get a smooth and fast start to the attack, which will significantly save time in battle.

Enjoy the satisfaction of getting off to a fast and effective start with just one click!

title: Archer ABB macro (with Avoid detection)
description:
This macro is designed to significantly increase your damage in the game, allowing you to deal up to 400% of your normal damage in just 1.4 seconds. Its development implements a random delay method that helps reduce the risk of detection by anti-cheat systems such as Hotshield.

Main functions:

- **Increased damage:** The macro executes commands effectively, maximizing your damage in a given time interval.
- **Detection protection:** Uses random time delays, which reduces the likelihood of detecting a macro.
- **Switching system:** Enables and disables the macro using a simple switching system. You can activate or deactivate it by pressing the assigned key.
- **Canceling animations:** When the macro is active, moving left and right cancels the animation, which is extremely important for achieving the best results.
- **Automatic movement:** Includes an automatic movement feature that needs to be configured for compatibility with various patches of the game.

This macro has been tested on both official and private servers, including projects such as 4Vision, 4Legacy and 4Classic.

How to use:

1. Set the macro to a key that is convenient for you.
2. Tie archer's basic skills to the keys (1, 2, 3, 7) ( Combat Arrow, Normal Attack, Explosive Arrow, Ruthless Shot).
3. Press the assigned key to activate the macro. As a result, you will be able to shoot four arrows in a row, and at the same time you will be able to use the Blinding Arrow skill as the fifth shot. This skill is not included in the macro so that you can use it for defensive purposes.
4. Be sure to disable the macro as soon as you deal with opponents or die. 

This approach will allow you to make the most of your fighting skills while taking care of your safety. Combining different functions will make your game more dynamic and effective.

   - Start completing level 29 in Chapter 2 of the treasure hunt.

3. Configure the macro to run after the start of the countdown:

   - Add a delay in the macro so that it starts at exactly the right moment.

4. Run the macro and wait for it to finish.

This unique macro will allow you to complete level 29 in Chapter 2 of the 3-star treasure hunt in the Age of Apes game, staying within the allotted 35 seconds. Make sure that the BlueStack emulator is set to a screen resolution of 1600x900 so that the macro works correctly.

title: ropes 1 chapter 94 level
description:
Macro for completing level 94 in Chapter 1 of the treasure hunt for 3 stars (34 seconds left) in the Age of Apes game, launched in the BlueStack emulator at a screen resolution of 1600x900:

1. Create a new macro with the following actions:
2. Click on the starting position where the time is displayed.
3. Wait 5 seconds for stability.
4. Click on the possible location of the first treasure.
5. Wait 2 seconds to detect the treasure.
6. Check the condition, if the first treasure is found, then go to step 8.
7. If the first treasure is not found, click on the next possible location of the treasure and go to step 5.
8. Click on the Collect found treasure button.
9. Wait 1 second for the treasure collection animation.
10. Repeat steps 4-9 for the remaining treasures.
11. After collecting all the treasures, click on the continue button.
12. Wait 1 second to go to the next level.
13. Check the condition: if there are less than 34 seconds left, then go to step 15.
14. If there are more than 34 seconds left, go back to step 2.
15. The macro is completed.

This macro will be activated at the start of the countdown and automatically perform the necessary actions to complete level 94 in chapter 1 of the 3-star treasure hunt.
